payload.reason: The evidence describes a systematic approach involving expert review to discover missing hypotheses in entailment problems.

claims.text: Missing hypotheses were discovered through a re-evaluation process by experts who were instructed to look for implicit hypotheses in entailment problems.
A new corpus of entailment problems was created by identifying missing hypotheses with the help of a crowd of experts, ensuring a comprehensive approach to testing natural-language inference.
42% of problems required additional hypotheses for entailment to hold, indicating that many missing hypotheses were not initially detected by experts.
